definitions.explanation: A country that exports goods, resources, or products to other countries, especially one known for a particular export.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{自動車|じどうしゃ}の{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}だ。
{主要|しゅよう}な{石油|せきゆ}{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}が{会議|かいぎ}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: The major oil-exporting countries held a conference.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{農産物|のうさんぶつ}の{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}と{輸入国|ゆにゅうこく}の{間|あいだ}で{貿易|ぼうえき}{摩擦|まさつ}が{起|お}きている。
examples.english: In this region, trade friction has arisen between agricultural exporting and importing countries.

notes:
A compound of {輸出|ゆしゅつ} (export) and {国|こく} (country). The {国|こく} suffix is productive for forming country-type labels: {先進国|せんしんこく} (developed country), {途上国|とじょうこく} (developing country).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石油|せきゆ}{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}: oil-exporting country
- {最大|さいだい}の{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}: the largest exporter
- {輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}{機構|きこう}: organization of exporting countries (as in OPEC)
- {純|じゅん}{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}: net exporter

SIMILAR/RELATED WORDS:
- {輸入国|ゆにゅうこく}: importing country — the counterpart
- {貿易国|ぼうえきこく}: trading nation — broader term covering both import and export
- {輸出|ゆしゅつ}: export (the act itself)
